Job Purpose :
To manage and optimize the performance of sales promotors across channels by ensuring effective deployment, capability development, performance tracking, and productivity monitoring to drive sales growth, product visibility, and customer advocacy

Main Responsibilities :
1. Determining the optimal headcount of promotors for each region and retail outlet based on foot traffic and sales potential.
2. Monitoring daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets for the promotor force, identifying underperformers for coaching or reallocation.
3. Ensure promotors are equipped with selling skills, customer engagement techniques, and brand knowledge.
4. Ensure promotors execute advocacy process, sales campaigns, new product offering, and merchandising standards
5. Maintaining the relationship with third-party manpower agencies to ensure quality recruitments

Employment Status:

Contract (C)

What you will do but not limited to:

• Assist the product team throughout the product development cycle, including ideation, wireframing, and prototype creation.
• Draft and help create Product Requirement Documents (PRD) that clearly define business needs, product features, and technical requirements.
• Conduct market research to understand industry trends, customer needs, and competitor landscapes.
• Collect and analyze data to support strategic decision-making.
• Gather user feedback to enhance the product experience and inform feature development.
• Use analytical tools to monitor product performance post-launch and identify areas for improvement.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, UI/UX design, marketing, and sales) to ensure product goals are aligned and delivered on time.
• Support the product team in various tasks and projects as needed.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Statistics, or related fields.
• Minimum 3 months of experience as a Product Manager Intern.
• Strong proficiency in Excel, Visio/Miro, and product management tools.
• Prior experience drafting PRDs or similar product specifications (highly preferred).
• Experience with no-code prototyping tools and/or Business Analysis in a fast-paced environment.
• Strong analytical skills, solid business understanding, and a fast learner.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Detail-oriented and well organized.

Supervise and execute day-to-day FP&A activities including data collection, budget preparation, and forecast updates.

Support preparation of financial reports, dashboards, and performance summaries.

Monitor actual versus budget performance and identify key variances.

Coordinate with business units to gather financial inputs and validate assumptions.

Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data and planning models.

Support implementation and usage of planning tools and systems.

Provide guidance and support to analysts and junior team members.

Assist in identifying opportunities to improve financial planning processes and reporting efficiency.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
